t: The Planmaker's Blueprint: A No-Break Refactor with an AI Shim
s: This entry details the author's deliberate refactoring of a core class, guided by an AI, to ensure progress without breaking existing functionality. It traces the historical lineage of software development paradigms and tools that influenced the author's approach.
sub: Historical lineage of operating systems and languages (*nix, C, Python, Lisp)
Evolution of web frameworks (Rails, microframeworks, Flask, FastAPI)
